(First GridView)
1-1. Confirm that the grouping filter box is displayed at the top of the first GridView.
1-2. Set the filter in the first GridView.
1-3. Confirm that the filtering condition is displayed in the top box.
1-4. Drag the header of the first GridView to perform grouping.
1-5. Confirm that both the filtering condition and grouping condition are displayed in the top box.
1-6. Confirm that expanding the top box displays all previously applied filtering and grouping conditions.

(Second GridView)
2-1. Confirm that the second GridView does not have a grouping filter box at the top.
2-2. Set a filter on the second GridView.
2-3. Confirm that the filter condition is not displayed at the top of the second GridView.
